steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setUiMode?.('simple'); s.reresolveFeatureFlags?.(); })()

steps.name: apply-resale-asis
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.setSmartStartOpen(false); s.applyResaleAsIs(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: apply-stripout
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.applyResaleStripout(); return JSON.stringify({ items: s.items ? undefined : 0 }); })()

steps.name: report-stripout
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); return JSON.stringify({ items: s.items.map(i=>i.defId), mainBedFloor: s.finishes.floor.mainBedroom, bath1Floor: s.finishes.floor.bath1, mainBedLeaf: s.doors['door-mainBedroom']?.leaf ?? null }); })()

steps.name: report-bare
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); return JSON.stringify({ items: s.items.length, plumbing: (s.floorPlan.plumbingPoints||[]).length, mainBedFloor: s.finishes.floor.mainBedroom, mainBedLeaf: s.doors['door-mainBedroom']?.leaf ?? null, mainDoorLeaf: s.doors['door-main']?.leaf ?? null }); })()
